name: OKC_DTS_DELIVERABLES_B_H
description: OKC_DTS_DELIVERABLES_B_H contains deliverable tracking information for given line in a contract. It includes order information that can be used to initiate orders in external systems from withing contract system.

columns.name: DELIVERABLE_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier. Primary key column of the table.

columns.name: CHR_ID
columns.description: ID of the contract to which this line belongs. The field will have a value only for parent lines. Refers to ID in OKC_K_HEADERS_B.

columns.name: CLE_ID
columns.description: ID of the contract line. Refers to ID in OKC_K_LINES_B.

columns.name: DELIVERABLE_NUM
columns.description: Sequential line number. Number that represents a deliverable uniquely within a line hierarchy

columns.name: DIRECTION
columns.description: The direction of deliverable. (Inbound/Outbound)

columns.name: DELIVERABLE_TYPE
columns.description: Identifies the type of deliverable.

columns.name: DEFAULTED_YN
columns.description: Defaulted from contract line flag

columns.description: Indicates line type

columns.name: ITEM_ID
